title: Elf Bar 600 Cola Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Designed for use with the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these Cola pods offer a simple and flavourful way to keep your device topped up. Each pack includes two 2ml prefilled pods, each loaded with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, providing up to 600 puffs depending on usage. The pods are inhale-activated and deliver a smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw that feels familiar and satisfying, with no buttons, refilling, or coil changes required. The Cola flavour captures the unmistakable taste of a fizzy cola soda, blending sweet caramel-like notes with a tangy twist and a lightly sparkling character. It’s a nostalgic and refreshing flavour that tastes instantly recognisable and easy to enjoy all day. Swapping pods is quick and hassle-free — when one is finished, just click in a fresh pod and carry on vaping. These prefilled pods provide a mess-free, reliable way to enjoy Elf Bar’s signature blends in a more sustainable format.
